page.overview:
What is A Very Fine Item?

A very fine item was a joke item from Java Edition 20w14∞, found only in the dimension.

The texture of a very fine item resembles the side face of a grass block with the words "Home Sweet Home" written on it. Unlike most items, its texture is 64x64 pixels, rather than the usual 16x16.

A very fine item can only be obtained from an item frame in the dimension. There is a maximum of 1 fine item that can be found legitimately in any world.

This item can't be found in the creative inventory, but it can be middle-click duplicated in creative mode or given with the command.
